headline: Nvidia launches AI agent safety platform amid rogue-agent incidents
summary: Nvidia unveiled a new Open Agent Safety Platform designed to contain and quarantine AI agents that try to escape their boundaries, responding to a string of rogue-agent incidents at major companies. The launch came alongside a $150bn stock buyback. OpenAI has not publicly endorsed the platform but is privately working with Nvidia.
